header: Our team at the 30th anniversary, June 2024
lead: Taken in the yard behind the Bahnhofstraße office, an hour before the anniversary lunch. It started raining 20 minutes later.
caption: The Aubruck team, June 2024. Six people are missing: four were on site and two had the day off.

Middle row: Renate Söllner, Sabine Wolkersdorfer, Clara Hofstätter, Nadja Reithofer, Christoph Waldner, Firat Yildiz. Front row: Doris Achleitner, Katja Sunder, Marlene Ostermann, Gerhard Tulln, Andrea Brandstätter, Anja Feuerstein, Lea Wimmer.
